skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the characteristics and properties of time series data, and apply basic and advanced methods for analysis and forecasting.
Use specialized software (Eviews, R) for time series analysis and forecasting.
Perform regression analysis on time series data.
Estimate and evaluate time series models such as ARIMA, ECM, VAR, VECM, ARCH, GARCH.
Apply forecasting techniques for short-term and long-term predictions.
Demonstrate self-directed learning and research skills in time series analysis.
Evaluate risk using time series models.
Analyze and interpret time series data critically.
Work effectively in groups to analyze and forecast time series data.
